target: Shared newsletter and waitlist footer component

references: SaaS Maker AI Chat Footer browser custom element
SaaS Maker Portfolio Project Strip browser custom element

library.primary: SaaS Maker browser custom-element and footer patterns

customReplacement.reason: Existing footer packages do not provide an accessible, consented email capture form; browser-native static integration is required across Fleet surfaces.

contract.purpose: Give visitors a clear, low-friction way to request newsletter or waitlist email from a Fleet product footer, with consent captured alongside the address.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Give visitors a clear, low-friction way to request newsletter or waitlist email from a Fleet product footer, with consent captured alongside the address.
contract.audience: Visitors who want product updates or early access, and Fleet product teams embedding the shared footer form.
contract.job: Choose newsletter or waitlist, enter an email address, explicitly consent, and submit once.
contract.thesis: A compact direct line in the existing product footer, with no promotional panel or new account step.
contract.system: Precise inherited typography, calm host-aware surfaces, semantic tokens, clear field labels, green success, and a single responsive row that stacks on narrow screens.
contract.signature: The consent sentence changes with the selected message kind, so visitors can see exactly what they are agreeing to before submitting.
contract.risk: A shared footer capture can feel promotional; keep it visually quiet, optional, and limited to one action.

ownerFeedback.note: Owner selected visual direction 02, Direct line: compact precise typography, calm surfaces, green success/status; newsletter/waitlist beside AI Chat Footer and Project Strip; feedback remains separate.
